AccpTaskEnvelope generated from real selection/runtime event

workerResult.accp is populated with compiled ACCP artifacts in worker adapter/runtime

TUI Tab opens ACCP mode picker in live TUI path
Current ACCP mode is visible in user-facing TUI
File picker is reassigned away from Tab to @ or Ctrl+P
P49 validation chain produces onefile evidence and machine-readable scorecard
